purpose: Make evidence-backed standards applicability, clause traceability, atomic audit, governed repair, independent convergence, and real proof the canonical full project-import procedure.
identity_separation: Applicability, audit, repair, and independent acceptance use distinct identities. Seeds remain idle and working clones never create subagents.
concurrency: At most six isolated repair clones may be admitted concurrently, and every heavyweight or write action requires Scheduler custody.
completion_rule: No fully-compliant recommendation is allowed while an applicable mandatory clause lacks traceability/current evidence/required proof/independent acceptance, or while UNKNOWN_BLOCKED, a dirty accepted candidate, an untested required real-host leg, an authority conflict, or missing rollback identity remains.
claim_boundary: The evidence pack is not legal certification, regulatory approval, security perfection, or universal compliance.
